features.quote: No variants whose only function is to humiliate a model
every "impossible/underspecified" variant must have a documented, model-independent reason it's hard
features.justification_quote: so we measure model behavior, not prompt trickery

features.quote: Clean give-up is a pass. If you penalize all abandonment you'll train models to thrash forever

features.quote: Scope to your own platform. Run only against models/deployments you own or are explicitly authorized to test
features.justification_quote: that's abuse, and depending on volume, plausibly a ToS / unauthorized-load problem

features.quote: Sandbox isolation is mandatory. Impossible tasks invite destructive edits; keep it ephemeral and network-free
features.justification_quote: so a flailing agent can't reach anything

features.quote: Human in the loop for severity. Auto-judge for triage scale, humans for the high-severity and low-confidence tail
